name: Gryphon Roost
summary: Perched along the ramparts just east of Stormwind's Trade District, the Gryphon Roost serves as the capital's primary transit hub for aerial travel. Managed by the human gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, it houses the majestic beasts that ferry couriers, soldiers, and adventurers across the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: Gateway to the Skies
sections.body: Situated atop the fortifications overlooking the Trade District canal, the Gryphon Roost connects the capital with outlying Alliance garrisons and settlements throughout the Eastern Kingdoms. The flight network is orchestrated by the seasoned master Dungar Longdrink, who coordinates routes to Ironforge, Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill, and beyond.

sections.title: A Touch of the Aerie
sections.body: While Stormwind is predominantly a kingdom of men, the presence of gryphons and their handlers brings a bit of Hinterlands tradition directly into the city walls. Gryphons have long been revered partners of the Wildhammer clan, who introduced aerial warfare and transport to the broader Alliance during the Second War. Here on the roost, the salty smell of leather, feed, and fresh winds creates a distinct frontier atmosphere amid the city's stone masonry.

faq.q: Where is the Gryphon Roost located in Stormwind?
faq.answer: The roost is perched on the eastern ramparts accessible via a stairway directly leading up from the Trade District, overlooking the canals between the Trade District and Old Town.
Dungar Longdrink, a human flight master, oversees the roost. He organizes routes and rents out trained gryphons to travelers bound for allied settlements across the continent.

faq.q: Why are dwarves running the roost in a human city?
faq.answer: Stormwind's flight master, Dungar Longdrink, is human. The Wildhammer dwarves have a long tradition of gryphon riding, but the roost's flights are managed by Dungar.

faq.q: Where can the gryphons fly from here?
faq.answer: The roost connects Stormwind with Alliance destinations such as Sentinel Hill, Lakeshire, Darkshire, and Ironforge. Further connections lead to other settlements across the Eastern Kingdoms.

angles.text: The Gryphon Roost serves as an essential bridge between dwarven aviation traditions and the human capital, with trained gryphons keeping Stormwind connected to Khaz Modan.
Aerial courier lines operating out of the roost are vital for coordinating Alliance responses across troubled territories like Westfall and Redridge.
